messages:
maria.le: Quick sync — I ran q8b-v2 (post-quant) through the eval harness and saw a sporadic drop vs q8b-v1 on core instruction set. Proposing a SLO-aware dynamic circuit-breaker that can auto-fallback the canary when quality or error signals cross thresholds.

maria.le: Proposal (high level):
- start canary at 5%
- allow slow ramp to 25% with gated checks every 10m
- trip and auto-fallback if weighted-quality drops >3% OR adverse-error-rate multiplies by >=3x OR 95p latency regresses >50ms for 3 consecutive windows

ajordan: can you paste the exact metric definitions? weighted-quality = ? and what window/sample min?

maria.le: weighted-quality = 0.6*instr-follow + 0.3*toxicity-auc + 0.1*coherence (same as eval harness); window = 10m sliding, min_samples = 250. Rationale: instr-follow is most product-relevant so it's weighted.

samir: quick A/B from a 5% canary run (1000 invocations over 30m):
- q8b-v1 baseline instr-follow: 92.4%
- q8b-v2 canary instr-follow: 89.7% (:warning:) -> delta -2.7%
- toxicity AUC: 0.81 -> 0.79 (delta -0.02)
- errors (503/timeout): baseline 0.3% -> canary 0.9% (3x)
- p95 latency baseline 210ms -> canary 265ms

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: q8b-v2 -> 5% traffic (id: canary-1797654321)

kai: two quick thoughts — 1) noise on tiny prompt subset can push the threshold, add 30m hysteresis and require 3 successive windows to trip. 2) require min_traffic=500 reqs per window so we don't flip on small samples.

maria.le: +1, updating policy now. Proposed JSON snippet for rollout guard:

```
{"guard": "slo_circuit_breaker",
 "start_traffic_pct": 5,
 "max_traffic_pct": 25,
 "check_interval_minutes": 10,
 "trip_conditions": [
   {"metric":"weighted_quality_delta","threshold":-0.03,"consecutive_windows":3},
   {"metric":"error_rate_ratio","threshold":3.0,"consecutive_windows":2},
   {"metric":"p95_latency_delta_ms","threshold":50,"consecutive_windows":3}
 ],
 "min_samples_per_window":250,
 "hysteresis_minutes":30,
 "fallback_action":"rollback_to:q8b-v1"
}
```

ops-bot: monitor attached: canary-1797654321 -> evaHarness/metrics stream subscribed

samir: logs from harness (snippet):
```
[00:10] eval: window=10m samples=270 instr_follow: 90.1 (baseline 92.4) delta=-2.3%
[00:20] eval: window=10m samples=310 instr_follow: 89.9 delta=-2.5% errors=0.8% (ratio=2.67)
[00:30] eval: window=10m samples=290 instr_follow: 89.7 delta=-2.7% errors=0.9% (ratio=3.0)
```

maria.le: at 00:30 we hit error_rate_ratio == 3.0 (meets threshold) and sample counts ok. With config consecutive_windows=2 on error_ratio it should trigger fallback.

ops-bot: ALERT: slo_circuit_breaker triggered for canary-1797654321 -> executing fallback: rollback_to:q8b-v1 (initiated by automation) :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: rollback complete, traffic restored to q8b-v1 for canary group (5% continuity maintained). Incident ticket created: IR-1797654321.

ajordan: good. Post-mortem action item — add prompt-type stratification in eval to avoid aggregate masking. Also add a dedicated hallucination check (we saw some coherence dips in longer-turn dialogs).

kai: also useful: expose a synthetic 'stability score' that blends jitter in instr_follow and error_rate over 1h, so we can avoid flip-flopping with short-lived noise.

maria.le: Agreed. Action items: 1) lock config above into rollout policy repo (I'll PR), 2) add prompt-stratified eval buckets and hallucination test, 3) add stability_score alert to Ops dashboard, 4) run a widened A/B with 10k samples before next canary.

samir: I'll attach the full harness csv and the quick plots to the ticket.

maria.le: Thanks all — landing PR today and will schedule re-run once PR merged. :white_check_mark:
